blocks.t: To increase the reliability of Atari Footba11™ Trak Bali™ assembly, the screws that hold the top metal plate to the Trak Ball assembly have been changed to: Part #85-1808B socket cap screw,flat counter sunk, 8/32 x 1/2" long, black oxide
(This new screw replaces the old Part #75-3806S match screw 82° flat counter sunk head 8/32 x 3/8" long.)
This change should lengthen the life of the assembly and prevent the screws from vibrating loose.

Steering PCB , To prevent possible damage to steering PCB's on Atari Footbal1™, the mounting hardware for the steering PCB should have nyjock and self-locking nuts to secure the PCB to the Trak Bal1T™ assembly.
The part # for this nut is 75-990504C, nut, hex, self-locking, polymer, shallow pattern #4-40.
The screw for this is a pan head machine screw #4-40 x 1/2" long, part #72-1408s.
These will insure that vibration will not loosen the steering PCB mounting hardware.
